sv.title: Emilia, 18 om scoutboomen: ”Ungdomar är trötta på det uppkopplade”

en.title: Emilia, 18, on the scouting boom: "Young people are tired of being connected"
en.summary: Interest in scouting continues to grow. The number of scout members has now risen for twelve years in a row. Over 1,500 scouts met in Jönköping this weekend.
